case.summary: Transaction 3524668 ($49.92) on card C09616-K1 was flagged via model monitoring with an advanced model score of 0.992 despite a low legacy risk score. Graph investigation revealed that device D000431 is tied to 10 prior confirmed fraud cases and exhibited a 6.35 fraud lift across multiple compromised cards during the active window, including C08374-K1, C04965-K2, and C07196-K2. In addition, card C09616-K1 has zero legitimate baseline activity, with its only prior transaction confirmed as fraud in closed case CC-2294. The transaction was determined to be card-not-present fraud, resulting in a card block, regulatory reporting, and connected card monitoring.

sar.narrative: This suspicious activity report details suspected card-not-present fraud conducted against customer C09616 on card C09616-K1. On December 8, 2016, at 14:14:33 UTC, an unauthorized online transaction (ID 3524668) for $49.92 was initiated in billing region 476. The transaction was conducted through device D000431, displaying a browser profile of Windows and Edge 16.0. Transaction 3524668 generated a second-generation fraud model score of 0.992, corresponding to a calibrated 92.1% historical fraud probability. Device D000431 is linked to 10 previous closed fraud investigations, including cases CC-5057, CC-3580, CC-3491, and CC-2765, all confirmed as fraudulent. A shared-origin network analysis revealed that device D000431 demonstrated a 6.35 fraud lift within a seven-day window, conducting eight suspicious transactions across four distinct card numbers. Specifically, device D000431 was concurrently utilized to exploit connected cards C04965-K2, C07196-K2, and C08374-K1 between December 8 and December 10, 2016. Further review showed that card C09616-K1 lacked any verified legitimate cardholder transaction history, with its only prior transaction confirmed as unauthorized fraud in case CC-2294. Based on the shared device compromise across unrelated cards and the absence of legitimate cardholder authorization, the transaction represents coordinated card-not-present fraud. The financial institution blocked card C09616-K1 to mitigate ongoing losses, with total exposure for this episode amounting to $49.92.
